en: Black‑and‑white seaside scene showing a sandy beach with scattered grass and a large pine tree in the foreground. A promenade or sandy road runs along the shoreline toward several grand wooden seaside hotels or villas with balconies and a pointed tower. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the path; women wear long dresses and men wear suits and overcoats. Behind the buildings is a wooded hill, giving the impression of a Baltic or North Sea resort town.
